title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: fit of the goods at the decision — class, lane, equipment, port and booking
content:
## Rule
When a review of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product is decided, the goods fit the category only if, on the acceptance as it stands at the decision:
1. its IMDG class is one of the category's eligible classes and its packing group one of the category's eligible packing groups;
2. its trade lane is one of the category's allowed trade lanes;
3. the booking carrying the goods has an equipment type among the category's allowed equipment types;
4. that booking has a port of discharge outside the category's prohibited ports;
5. that booking is recorded with cargo type dangerous goods and is live, meaning its status is requested, confirmed or equipment released.

## Where each test is read
| Test | Record read |
|---|---|
| Class and packing group | the acceptance |
| Trade lane | the acceptance |
| Equipment type | the booking carrying the goods |
| Port of discharge | the booking carrying the goods |
| Cargo type and status | the booking carrying the goods |

## Booking status at the decision
| Booking status | Live for the decision |
|---|---|
| requested, confirmed or equipment released | yes |
| gated in, or any other status | no |

## Points of judgement
- *The shipper's amendment changed the packing group before the decision — which packing group is tested?* The one on the acceptance as it stands at the decision.
- *The booking has already been gated in when the review is decided — does it pass test 5?* No; only requested, confirmed and equipment released count as live for this test.
- *Is the port tested against a list of allowed ports?* No; it is tested against the category's prohibited ports, and passes when it is not on that list.
